svg.text: VelcrowAI - architecture, tech stack and algorithms
Python 3.14, FastAPI 0.141, Uvicorn, SQLite, React 18, Vite, Tailwind 4 - every number read from the code, 2026-09-05
reads one manifest, imports no code
6 tabs: chains, trace, dispute, deals, lab, trust
THE VELCROWAI LAYER :8003 - five agents, one wallet
plain Python, no framework: routing, APScheduler 3.11 for the unattended runs,
every handoff between agents chain-logged as orchestrator_handoff
stock seen only as in / out
ties -> a fact for the model
Beta(alpha, beta) per shop x kind, stdlib
restock / cart / goal offers, say-once per person per item, OTP + link login
mandates: PyJWT HS256, caps + expiry + nonce
approvals: cart-bound HMAC JWT over a SHA-256 item hash
trust score per shop: halves on any violation (common/trust.py)
OTP: 5-minute life, burned after 3 attempts, hashed
quote and pay refuse until link login
httpx to the same endpoints as every door
common/wallet.py - the only door to money
Razorpay Python SDK, test mode, 76 lines, the only file allowed to import it (test-enforced)
5 ordered checks: mandate valid, amount matches, not spent before, shop trusted, price unchanged -> PRICE_CHANGED refuses
every surface and dialect pays through the same file
MERCHANT NETWORK - one codebase, six configs
coupons engine, price lock + stock holds
demand ledger: outstanding / told / recovered / lapsed
negotiation: floor = cost x 11,200 basis points,
cheat mode: inflate the bill after approval
trust the agent's arithmetic, expose a stock number
to the model, or accept money outside /order
in: catalog, cart, order, negotiate, proposals
back: restock / cart callbacks, typed errors
one append-only JSONL per actor: 6 shops + buyer
Verify recomputes all; Tamper edits one line on disk
offers, outbox, chats, goals, OTPs, link logins, processed ids
stock, carts, orders (with source), demand ledger,
chains / trace / dispute / negotiations / revenue lab / trust
determinism check, negotiation demo, third-party ACP buyer
414 passing; ast import guards on Razorpay,
OpenAI and Meta; agent URL pinned to a dead port
every real bug, cause, fix, regression test
including the ones found live on demo day
Doctrine: models make the judgments; every rule that touches money is code that can refuse; nowhere does a model do arithmetic on money, choose a price, or see a stock number.
Not used, on purpose: no LangChain or LangGraph (orchestration is plain Python, every handoff on the chain); no fine-tuned model (the only learning is the bandit); no floats on money.
Algorithms in one line: LLM function calling (2 agents), lexical catalog scoring (router), rule-based trust-weighted ranking (buyer), Thompson sampling (strategy order),
HS256 JWT mandates and approvals, HMAC-SHA256 price tokens and webhook signatures, SHA-256 hash chains, integer basis-point pricing with ceiling division, idempotency keys, say-once outreach.
